claims.evidence: Witness could not read a specific model variant from the photo; only a generic PlayStation logo was visible.

claims.claim: Hacked with FC26 and 8 other games
claims.evidence: Software/firmware state cannot be seen from a static photo of the console's exterior.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: Internal condition and casing screws are not visible in the photo.
Thermal/functional behavior cannot be judged from a still image; witness notes power-on state is not shown.
Witness explicitly lists port condition as not shown.
Two controllers are visible on the console, so presence is plausible, but their authenticity as official Sony pads versus third-party clones cannot be confirmed from the photo.
No receipt is visible in the photo; witness lists packaging/paperwork as not shown.

risks.risk: Console may be a modded/jailbroken unit with unstable or non-bootable firmware
risks.proof: Video of console powering on, booting to the home screen, and launching one of the listed games
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a basic unmodified PS4 with no added software value

risks.risk: Hidden internal wear, prior repair, or overheating issues not visible externally
risks.proof: Video showing console running for 10-15 minutes under load with fan noise and no shutdown
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case used condition with possible internal wear

risks.risk: Ports (HDMI, USB, power) may be damaged despite seller's claim
risks.proof: Clip showing HDMI output on a screen and a controller charging via USB port
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if one or more ports are non-functional

risks.risk: Storage capacity and exact model variant unknown
risks.proof: Photo of the system settings 'Storage' screen or the rear label with model/serial number
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the lowest common PS4 Fat storage tier

risks.risk: Controllers may be third-party clones rather than genuine Sony DualShock 4 pads
risks.proof: Close-up photo of each controller's rear showing the model number and certification markings
risks.if_unproven: Priced as generic/clone controllers, not official Sony pads

risks.risk: UK receipt may not match this specific unit or could be unrelated/fraudulent
risks.proof: Photo of the receipt showing matching serial number or purchase date consistent with the console
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if no proof of purchase exists

risks.risk: Jailbroken console may be banned from PSN or unable to receive official updates, limiting future usability
risks.proof: Screenshot of system software version and confirmation it can still access PSN or play discs/games normally

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and booting to the home screen
Clip showing gameplay of one of the installed games (e.g., FC26) running smoothly
Close-up photo of the rear label showing model number and serial number
Photo of system storage settings showing capacity
Close-up photos of both controllers' rear casing showing model numbers
Photo of the UK receipt with legible date and any serial/reference number
Video demonstrating HDMI and USB port functionality
response.reason: The witness confirms a PlayStation console with two controllers, so it can be priced at worst case as an unverified, possibly modded, unverified-condition PS4 pending further proof.
